name: Research Agent
description: The reference agent for Witness. It asks a human to approve each action before it spends anything; it holds no authority of its own. Its on-chain identity is owned by the AgentExecutor contract, so the identity it claims and the authority a human grants are the same address.

services.name: MCP
services.description: Not implemented in this deployment. Declared here so integrators see the intended surface rather than an implied one.

notes: This agent can only move value that a human approved with a passkey, for this exact recipient and amount.
Every refusal is enforced on-chain by the counterparty holding the funds, not by this agent.
Verification state is visible at https://witness-agent.vercel.app under Security details.
